The '''JT-731 Broadhorn transport''',<ref name="Dawn" /> simply known as the '''Jabiim freight transport''', was a model of utilitarian [[Freighter|freight]] [[transport]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] used during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Databank" /> Two of these transports were used by the [[Hidden Path]], a resistance underground network that smuggled [[Jedi]] and other [[Force-sensitive]]s away from the [[Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Part IV" /> due to the fact that refuse and maintenance craft were often overlooked by Imperial patrols. The ship had data and power conduits located on the outer hull to maximize internal cargo space.<ref name="Dawn" /> In [[2 BBY]], one of these ships was used to transport [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] soldiers to [[Great Temple|Base One]] on [[Yavin 4]] to be initiated into [[Massassi Group]].<ref name="Messenger" />
